title: An Optimized Toolbox for Advanced Image Processing with Tsetlin Machine Composites
new_feature: A toolbox of 22 convolutional TM specialists using seven image Booleanizations (incl. novel adaptive colour thermometers), Optuna-tuned and trained with/without flip augmentation, combined in a TM Composite; reaches 82.8% on CIFAR-10.

datasets.split_as_reported: 50,000 train / 10,000 test; 'Augmented' specialists train on 100,000 images (originals + horizontal flips)
datasets.booleanization: per specialist: Canny edge detection, adaptive mean / adaptive Gaussian / Otsu thresholding (per RGB channel), HOG thresholded at 0.1, colour thermometers, adaptive colour thermometers (multilevel thresholding)
datasets.notes: Accuracy = mean of last 25 of 250 epochs
